extraction.notes: Three-month 2026 column used. Starting line is GAAP net loss attributable to common stockholders. The gain on sale of real estate line is a dash for 2026, recorded as 0. Totals verified: -3955+6712+2208+0-4=4961; 4961-283-19+836+305+42+47=5889. Diluted share count 18,737,530 printed in full, converted to 18,737.53 thousands; 4961/18737.53=0.26 and 5889/18737.53=0.31, matching reported per-share figures. BRT reports no core FFO. AFFO does not deduct recurring capex, so the recurring capex disclosure was taken from the Capital Expenditures table on printed page 13. That table is in whole dollars ($1,658,000 BRT share), converted to 1,658 thousands. The table's recurring capex figure is an estimate for the quarter and includes units across the portfolio; the basis is recorded as quarter.
